arm_config.projection: Identical constrained_budget.project_budget for all three projected arms
arm_config.tie_rule: strict original float32 energy improvement; first encountered exact tie

command: Independent canary/factory/context workers on shared host; sampler restricted to CPU0 and one BLAS thread; no TSU timing claim
concurrent_jobs: Independent canary/factory/context workers on shared host; sampler restricted to CPU0 and one BLAS thread; no TSU timing claim
limitations: Synthetic verifier and token labels; no consumed model tokens or Hermes outcome.
JAX CPU simulation; no Z1/TSU speed or energy claim.
Task is the statistical unit; seeds and chain draws are not independent tasks.
Compilation caches are shared across arms in the recorded order; per-arm incurred compilation is not isolated cold-start latency.
First-valid diagnostic and trace writing are included in experiment wall, separately reported.
Exact/component oracle construction is separate evaluation infrastructure, never sampler input.
Any scale stage requires manual preceding-gate review; this runner does not auto-promote.

adaptive_arm_configuration.continuation: Each next stage starts at the last retained states of previous stage; retain all stages for frozen-objective final ranking, including empty states.
adaptive_arm_configuration.limitation: This changes the sampler schedule, not the frozen scoring objective. Host price adaptation remains global software work.
adaptive_arm_configuration.second_stage_initializer: 16 bisections of independent-spin expected occupancy toward 0.8 * budget, ignoring pair interactions explicitly

frozen.sample_order: retained sweep major, then chain; chain draws are correlated and not independent tasks
frozen.verifier: Task.verify, unchanged; token feasibility reported separately

hybrid_controls.auxiliary_initialization: Report the initial item pack, initial original score, auxiliary constraint satisfaction, and whether sampler states ever change, to detect frozen slack chains.
hybrid_controls.label: A host repair/projection of THRML draws is not exact constrained Gibbs and does not prove that constraints are implemented on a TSU.
hybrid_controls.requirement: For a host-projected THRML proposal arm, include identical projection of prototype proposals and random proposals; isolate proposal quality from deterministic repair.

integrity.adaptive_budget: All adaptation rounds share the same total sweep and retained-draw budget. No additional samples after observed failure.
integrity.auxiliary_penalty: Sampler Hamiltonians may add preregistered budget penalties; report their energy separately. Every output is rescored by the identical original Task.energy.
integrity.exact_reference: Minimum frozen energy over all token-feasible subsets, including empty; never condition on verifier success.
integrity.oracle_separation: Sampler and its warm start may use only item relevance, tokens, sparse interactions and budget. Required_ids, necessary, expected, facts and verifier outputs are evaluation-only.
integrity.parameters: Publish complete fixed arm configurations and hashes before full-cohort measurement. Engineering smoke tests are reported separately; no choosing parameters from oracle-cohort outcomes without declaring a new exploratory wave.
integrity.randomness: Same seed schedule does not imply identical PRNG draws or transition kernels. Distributional/cohort parity is distinct from bitwise trajectory reproduction.
integrity.recording: Emit every task x stochastic arm x seed, including failures; do not select the best seed. Deterministic arms run once per task and are not replicated into independent statistical observations.
integrity.selection: Return lowest frozen-energy token-feasible retained proposal, independent of Task.verify and required_ids. Report no feasible proposal explicitly. No hidden exact optimizer or verifier-based reranker.

interpretation.decision_GO: GO means advance a sparse candidate that passes empirical gates to separately frozen real-evidence replay, subject to deterministic frontier and full overhead; never production activation or Hermes benefit.
interpretation.decision_KILL: Deterministic alternatives, including separately labeled component-DP, dominate at equal verified quality and lower measured overhead, or the claimed signal fails reproduction or depends on forbidden oracle information/dense coupling. Scope the rejection to tested mechanism and cohort.
interpretation.decision_MODIFY: The signal remains bounded but the current formulation, controls, sparsity or scale gates fail. State a narrow falsifiable next modification, without claiming acceptance.
interpretation.statistical_unit: Task, not chain or seed. Report paired task-level results; 12 related synthetic tasks per N cannot certify a small population noninferiority margin.
interpretation.synthetic_scope: Generator deliberately rewards a known three-item synergy and traps one-step greedy. Issue intent pins required evidence outside sampler, but this frozen reproduction does not. Preserve this mismatch as a limitation; do not silently repair it mid-experiment.

protocol.question: Does genuine THRML preserve the frozen small-N signal, and can sparse budget formulations preserve it at larger N without selecting empty or over-budget context?

reproducibility.independent_audit: Independently enumerate small-N oracle, rescore returned masks, validate complete grid, audit trajectory selection where traces available, and distinguish verified audit facts from uncheckable claims.
reproducibility.outputs: Create-only row-level results; retain failed runs and negative results. Include sampler input/returned mask so frozen score, tokens and verifier can be recomputed offline.
reproducibility.sampling_trace: Persist retained item masks or lossless packed masks sufficient to independently check first-valid sample, selection and sample budgets; final masks alone cannot validate trajectory-derived claims.

required_comparators: exact frozen constrained optimum for N <= 16
real THRML with the same fixed small-N Hamiltonian
constrained or bucket formulation where implementable; host projection must be labeled hybrid
pair-lookahead deterministic greedy, using no oracle facts
explicit deterministic connected-component enumeration plus token-knapsack DP; independently validate against exhaustive small-N optimum before using as labeled large-N exact reference

scale_gates.diagnosis: Report feasibility rate, emptiness, output correctness, mean/worst task loss, constraint violations, chain motion, clipping/saturation, and relevant host work. Do not hide a bounded-budget failure by increasing sampling.
scale_gates.stop_rule: Complete preregistered independent arms at the current N. At the first N where an advancing budget candidate clearly fails, stop the entire scale ladder and mark all larger N NOT_RUN. Expected failure of the fixed-price prototype reference is a control, not a new-candidate scale failure.

small_N_gates.genuine_THRML_parity_label: Compare real fixed-Hamiltonian THRML against same-run frozen prototype on verified successes and fixed-energy gaps. Also report disagreement with historical published aggregate results without silently rewriting history.
small_N_gates.report_additionally: Report each seed and task, worst-task success, energy-gap median/max/tails, successful-pack token frontier, samples-to-first-valid including censored failures, and pair-lookahead baseline performance. Failing low-token packs are not a savings frontier.
small_N_gates.scope: Each N separately, 12 tasks x 8 seeds = 96 stochastic rows. These are empirical screening rules, not certified population noninferiority.

sparsity.claim_limit: The degree screen is a chosen sparse CPU-experiment criterion, not an Extropic hardware topology or supported TSU limit. No Z1/TSU latency or energy claim.
sparsity.degree_scope: All variables and all interaction/factor scopes, including auxiliary/carry/slack nodes. Report item-only and full-expanded graphs separately, with node count, edge count, mean degree, maximum degree and coloring blocks.
sparsity.higher_order_factors: Report factor arity and induced variable-neighbor degree; do not hide all-to-all coupling in a single global factor.
sparsity.host_constraints: Report nonlocal CPU projection/controller work explicitly; graph sparsity alone does not establish local execution of a budget constraint.

timing.compile_accounting: Report actual new executables, cache hits and static specialization keys. Do not call first compile plus execution warm latency.
timing.contention: Record CPU affinity/thread limits, platform/devices, concurrent jobs and timing mode. Contended parallel runs are not isolated latency benchmarks; report the limitation rather than attributing resource differences to algorithm performance.
timing.end_to_end: Total wall includes construction, compile when incurred, sampling, host budget control/repair, scoring and verification. Exact reference construction is reported separately as evaluation infrastructure.
timing.no_production_claim: Synthetic selected tokens are not actual consumed model tokens, and this synthetic verifier is not a downstream Hermes model outcome.
timing.synchronization: Block on JAX outputs before stopping each sampling timer; avoid measuring asynchronous dispatch only.
